name: SimObservationCode
title: Sim MetingNaamCode to a real code system
description: Example ConceptMap demonstrating CodeableConcept mapping: translates Observation.code.coding[].code (built from the sim source's MetingNaamCode/MetingNaamCodeSysteem columns, see queries/sim/fhir/observation.sql statement 2). Unlike gender, the source system here IS genuinely known - MetingNaamCodeSysteem flows straight through the pipeline into Observation.code.coding.system - so group.source is a real fact, not an inference. 'MayoEndoscopicScore' (test/data/sim/AlgemeneMeting.csv row 4) isn't a real code from that system; LA6751-7 below is illustrative only and should be checked against a real LOINC browser before this map is used for anything beyond demoing the Coding/CodeableConcept mapping path - verify before relying on it. The other MetingNaamCode values in that test file (MCD_A, MCD_L, MCD_B, MCD_P) are intentionally left unmapped here.
